approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would authorise spending from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for government services that are not part of its ordinary annual services.
It would provide about 7/12ths of the estimated annual appropriations for those non-ordinary services for the 2022-23 financial year.
The bill would also update which portfolios receive funding following a change to the Administrative Arrangements Order on 1 July 2022, including for two new departments.
Proposes appropriations from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for non-ordinary annual services.
Provides funding equivalent to about 7/12ths of estimated annual appropriations for those services.
Updates portfolio allocations to reflect the Administrative Arrangements Order that took effect on 1 July 2022.
Government departments and agencies that receive funding for non-ordinary annual services, including the two departments established on 1 July 2022.
